home.hero.title: We design brands people remember.
home.hero.description: Vetrina is a small studio for identity, editorial and digital work. This template ships the whole showcase: a striking home, a work grid and a contact form — all frontend, no backend required.
home.work.title: A few things we are proud of
home.work.description: Identity systems, product launches and printed matter for teams that care about the details.
home.features.title: Strategy, identity and digital product
home.features.description: One team from the first sketch to the shipped interface.
home.cta.title: Have a project in mind?
home.cta.description: Tell us what you are building. We answer every serious brief within two working days.
features.hero.title: A small team with a wide range.
features.hero.description: We work in tight cycles, keep the team small and bring specialists in only when the work asks for it.
features.process.title: How we work
features.process.description: Three steps, no mystery. Every phase ends with something you can look at.
features.process.1.title: Discover
features.process.1.body: Interviews, audits and a shared brief. We agree on what success looks like before opening a design file.
features.process.2.title: Design
features.process.2.body: Loops of sketches, prototypes and critique. You see the work every week, not at the end of a quarter.
features.process.3.title: Deliver
features.process.3.body: Production-ready files, a documented system and a handover session with your team.
showcase.hero.title: Work made to be seen.
showcase.hero.description: A selection of identity and digital projects. Every card is plain data in src/lib/content.ts — edit the list and the grid follows.
contact.hero.title: Let's make something good.
contact.hero.description: Write to us with the short version: what you are making, for whom, and when it has to be live.
